name: Stadt Wien Sommerkinos
notes: Static server-rendered HTML, one h2 block per festival with a free-text 'Termin(e):'/'Ort:' li list; no ld+json/API. Each festival's run is emitted as one continuous record (start..end), except Sunset Cinema (two disjoint venue+date pairs -> 2 records) and Architektur.Film.Sommer (comma-listed single dates -> one record per date, past ones dropped). price_min=0 only when an explicit 'Eintritt frei' li is present.
